meaning:
ἀγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἄγω), [in LXX: Est.2:20 10:3, 2Ma.4:16 6:8 11:24, 3Ma.4:10 * ;]
1. a carrying away.
2. a leading, guiding; metaphorically, training; hence, from the expression ἀ. τοῦ βίου, absol., conduct, way of life: 2Ti.3:10 (Cremer, 61; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
